newsitem.title: USA: FPC Crystal River 3 restart still unknown.
newsitem.headline: FPC Crystal River 3 restart still unknown.

text.p: The restart of Florida Power Corp's (FPC) 825 megawatt (MW) Crystal River 3 nuclear unit was still unknown after shutting automatically Sept 2 due to a leak in a lubrication oil line, the company said Wednesday.
"We're still off line...We don't have anything new," said FPC spokeswoman Melodye Hendrix.
Repair crews were still replacing a section of the lube oil line to the unit's turbine shaft, where the leak was discovered, she said. "They plan for it to take a while."
Crystal River produces 15 percent of the electricity FPC delivers in its Florida service territory.
The facility also has four fossil-fueled units, with a combined generating capacity of 2,276 MW.
Florida Power, a subsidiary of Florida Progress Corp, is the operator and majority owner of Crystal River 3. A total of ten Florida municipal utilities own the remaining interests in the unit.
